Deduplicate by event or request key
Create durable workflow record

span.p:
Read actual state
Capture timestamps and target versions

span.p:
Build typed plan
Version + hash + preconditions + compensation

span.p:
Rejected
Record reason; no side effect

span.p:
Await authorized approval

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Acquire scoped capability and target lease
Persist audit intent

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Still authorized, fresh
and inside impact limits?

span.p:
Execute one recorded activity
Idempotency key + external task ID

span.p:
Reconcile actual state
Query operation ID; do not retry blindly

span.p:
Commit receipt and observed state
Release lease; mark completed

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approved bounded compensation
Only when safe and applicable

div.style: color: rgb(209, 218, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Suspended for human recovery
Preserve partial state and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(235, 209, 165) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bounded retry or replan
Changed plan invalidates old approval
